Resumable streams validate event identity, payloads, and monotonic watermarks at the protocol boundary.

OpenAI compatibility remains composed behind the provider-neutral protocol facade.
Editor and agent rule documents have a bounded, provider-neutral import/export contract.

Mobile/client parity and bounded reconnect use the shared typed protocol graph.
Client schema generation is composed from the catalog through the protocol facade.
Provider lifecycle publication is composed into the live model/embedding path with fail-closed optional training and update lanes.

Domain logic remains separated from adapters and interfaces.
Application ports define the attended adaptive-training side-effect boundary.
Training infrastructure failures remain behind typed process, lock, journal, policy, and deployment ports.
The remaining command, slash-menu, and permission-policy callers use packaged compatibility boundaries rather than importing root implementation modules directly.
Import side effects are constrained at the package boundaries.
Runtime configuration is represented through typed application boundaries.
Architecture enforcement checks are present and executable.
Root compatibility paths are ratcheted against prohibited legacy exceptions.
Ownership catalog.

Persistence and compatibility boundaries preserve data while retiring obsolete implementation paths.
Independent authorities for tools, startup capabilities, updates, and self-modification remain explicit.
Training activation requires attended execution and qualification boundaries.

The runtime uses explicit local ports and adapters rather than transplanting an external framework authority.
The live application and runtime graphs expose one provider-neutral context-planning facade.
Context assembly applies typed section budgets and a bounded model input budget.
Priority selection and eviction are composed through the typed context selection policy.
Context records are deduplicated before prefix and replay manifests are built.
Context selection returns explainable typed selections rather than opaque concatenated text.
Complete context assemblies publish an isolated last-good snapshot for bounded recovery.
The context facade exposes bounded overflow preparation and recovery without provider calls.
Measured context capability can reduce the requested window without inventing hardware facts.
Stable prefix manifests and cache keys are composed from canonical retained context records.
Request replay manifests bind request identity, model, retained records, prefix key, and bounded metadata.
Persistence composition models per-domain SQLite ownership through a typed graph facade.
The persistence facade rejects cross-database transaction claims rather than implying distributed atomicity.
Typed record and outbox writes share one caller-owned SQLite transaction.
Revision compare-and-set is enforced by the SQLite persistence adapter.
Migration and ownership operations remain explicit typed persistence boundaries with fail-closed validation.
Epoch/adoption coordination remains represented by explicit persistence graph and CAS seams.
Immutable artifact manifests use deterministic canonical hashes at the persistence boundary.
A documentation authority index identifies current sources of truth.
Historical architecture and program documents are explicitly labeled.
New ADRs have a canonical date-prefixed namespace.
Focused contracts are documented in the generated inventory and architecture references.
Generated references are reproducible from typed runtime sources.
Requirement status and evidence are generated from the append-only ledger.
Documentation authority checks detect stale promises and out-of-date generated references.
Evaluation is exposed as a provider-neutral application service rather than a transport or evaluator implementation.
The evaluation service accepts bounded repository/tool/memory corpus coverage through the typed inventory port.
Evaluation suite and result metrics remain typed and provider-neutral at the application boundary.
Versioned evaluation dimensions and suite identity are composed through an immutable catalog boundary.
The application evaluation service exposes deterministic trajectory replay through an injected evaluator.
Replay and proposal result contracts preserve divergence and provenance evidence at the application boundary.
Promotion evidence requires explicit gates, replay equivalence, holdout success, rollback reference, and provenance before attended promotion.
The evaluation service composes explicit shadow and canary observation transitions before promotion.
Proposal creation, submission, evaluation, approval, promotion, rejection, withdrawal, and attended rollback are exposed through one typed service.
Execution exposes one typed application facade for world binding, containment, jobs, and output handling.
Execution containment and world policy remain explicit injected boundaries with fail-closed defaults.
Persistent terminal and process-world seams are exposed through the typed execution facade.
Execution output and spill references remain bounded injected services rather than unbounded in-memory text.
Remote execution is represented only as an explicit provider seam and is not silently enabled.
Execution isolation claims are carried by typed containment/world policy rather than inferred from a process call.
Bounded extension registry and explicit production facade exposure are composed; artifact discovery and execution promotion remain out of scope.
Deterministic typed extension manifest identity/dependency validation and manifest-digest admission are implemented; cryptographic verification remains out of scope.
Bounded child-process extension isolation is composed for live experiments and retains startup/call deadlines, output limits, restart budgets, crash budgets, and no-replay behavior.
Durable extension registry state preserves fail-closed admission, quarantine, disable, update, repair diagnostics, and crash evidence across reconstruction.
The live application composition publishes a durable, bounded extension inventory with manifest digest validation and repair visibility.
Ephemeral extension experiments use the bounded child host through live composition while remaining explicitly authorized and non-durable.
No automatic promotion.
Generic durable jobs can be started and polled through the composed SQLite registry.
Composed jobs support bounded poll/stream reads, monotonic output watermarks, durable inline previews, and spill references.
The composed application exposes bounded restart recovery and routes complete orphan process cleanup through the typed supervisor.
The composed subprocess provider uses the existing bounded process-tree cleanup contract and preserves incomplete cleanup truth.
Composed process output uses durable monotonic watermarks with bounded previews and durable spill references across restart.
The loop facade composes typed turn admission and lifecycle state.
Turn steps have typed open, transition, retry, completion, and reconciliation contracts.
Interception and ephemeral live events are separated from durable session facts.

Retry execution and durable facts retain explicit operation identity for idempotent behavior.

Logical roles and gateway contracts provide separate budget/routing ownership points for model callers.
